units.function: Pure tests classifying remote/local/GitHub shorthand import sources and normalizing GitHub repository/tree references.
units.dependencyDirection: Calls URL normalization helpers only; no HTTP client, DNS resolver, GitHub API or importer runs.
units.keyDataModels: HTTP(S) URL, GitHub owner/repository/path shorthand, ref query and local path forms.
units.lifecycle: Classifies source strings and converts shorthand/tree URLs into a canonical GitHub URL with ref/path query parameters.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 11/11. Basic source discrimination and encoding work, but plain HTTP and mutable refs are accepted; network trust, redirect/DNS/private-address controls, limits, authentication, integrity and provenance are absent.
units.designRationale: Offer convenient company-template import from GitHub without requiring users to construct raw content URLs.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS FDE templates need convenient remote distribution while remaining reproducible, legally traceable and safe from SSRF or supply-chain substitution.
units.companyOsFit: REJECT this trust contract. Require HTTPS, allowlisted provider adapters, resolved full commit SHA plus content digest/signature, redirect and DNS/IP revalidation, private-network denial by default, bounded fetches and persisted provenance/license metadata; shorthand UX can be reimplemented over that boundary.
units.responsibilityConflict: Importing mutable main or an arbitrary branch cannot bind the accountable human's approval to exact reviewed bytes and can silently change Agent permissions, instructions or company configuration.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 11 passed in combined 12-test run

units.function: Happy-path ZIP source resolver test for wrapper-root normalization, portable-file filtering and binary-blob preservation.
units.dependencyDirection: Calls production inline-source resolver with a locally generated stored ZIP and cleans temporary files; no server or database runs.
units.keyDataModels: ZIP entries, normalized rootPath, portable text-file map and base64 binary blob envelope.
units.lifecycle: Creates a ZIP, resolves allowed files under its wrapper directory, ignores unrelated text and returns a normalized in-memory package.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 1/1. Root and blob fidelity are covered, but no adversarial archive, size/count/ratio, CRC/encoding, signature/provenance, permission or atomicity case is present.
units.designRationale: Let users exchange a whole portable company package as one file while preserving binary assets.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs safe signed FDE/template bundles that carry selected organization and visual assets across deployment profiles.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the normalized in-memory envelope and explicit binary encoding, but use a hardened archive reader with canonical paths, duplicate/case/symlink rejection, strict entry/count/size/ratio limits, schema validation, digests/signatures, provenance/license metadata and staged cleanup.
units.responsibilityConflict: Without a signed manifest and exact digest, human approval cannot be tied to the bytes that introduce Agent instructions, permissions or executable extensions.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 1 passed in combined 12-test run
